lines.text: That silly song lives in my head rent-free.

data.define: Used when something stays in your thoughts all the time.

example.text: That silly song lives in my head rent-free.

misuse.text: Don't tell your landlord it lives 'rent-free'.

publish.title: What does "rent-free" mean?
publish.value: Rent-free = It won't leave my mind. Example: "That silly song lives in my head rent-free." (very casual English, US).
